vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Look! Two picnic pictures. But this sun has sunglasses!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Five things are different. Let's find them all!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Hmm, look again, Leo. The clouds are the same.

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: The blanket! Red here, and blue there!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The tree has apples. And this tree has none!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: My honey pot! It's gone! Oh no!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Ha ha! Look closely, Leo. He has two eyes, see?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Oh! But his bow is a different color!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The window! Daytime here, and nighttime there!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The lamp is on, and the lamp is off!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The fish! Orange here, purple there!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: The bubbles! Pop, pop, pop! No bubbles here!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Find five differences on the snowmen!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: This snowman lost his carrot nose!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Count the buttons. Three here... and two there!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: The scarf has stripes, and this one has no stripes!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Two of me? Which one is the real me?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The scarf! Red here, and blue there!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: This Bobo has a party hat!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: This Bobo is holding an apple!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: One Bobo is standing on a little rug!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And one Bobo has a balloon!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Ha ha! I like the one with the party hat and the balloon!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: How many buttons did the second snowman have?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: What did the crab turn into?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: What was missing from the picnic?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And what color was the other Bobo's scarf?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: In the toy room, what was different about the window?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Here is the trick. Look at one thing, then look at the same place in the other picture.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Look here, then look there! Your turn!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: See you next time, on Tiny Sparks!
